cards.title: Payment overview
intro: For Membership Payment plans, payments are only generated for the next period (month, quarter, or year). New payments will be created as long as the booking is active and the class has not ended.

cards.title: Change › 1. Payment set up
intro: This booking has discounts. By applying a new payment plan these discounts will be nullified.

fields.label: Choose
options: Scheduled payment amount: Custom amount — Enter the amount of the scheduled payment you want the client to pay. Template discounts will not be applied.

fields.label: Registration fee
fields.help: The Registration fee will be charged when the booking is created and will be added to the price of the programme or the first scheduled payment.

fields.label: Include full start date
fields.help: Includes all sessions that occurred on the selected start date. If disabled, only sessions after that date are included.

fields.label: The due date is the last day by which you need the money to be collected. After this date, the booking will change from the status “Awaiting for payment” to “Unpaid”.

notes: For Membership Payment plans, payments are only generated for the next period (month, quarter, or year). New payments will be created as long as the booking is active and the class has not ended.
